test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following international organizations approved a program to support women's employment in Tamil Nadu in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Bank (विश्व बैंक)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Bank** Board of Executive Directors approved a **$200 million** (approximately **INR 1,600 crore**) loan in **early 2025** to support the **Tamil Nadu Women’s Employment and Enterprise Program (TN-WEEP)**.
 
• The primary objective of this program is to enhance **female labor force participation** by connecting women to high-growth and formal sector jobs in **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• The program specifically targets emerging industries such as **electronics**, **electric vehicles (EVs)**, **renewable energy**, and **non-leather footwear**, sectors where the state is currently a manufacturing leader.
 
• It aims to provide skills training and job placement support to more than **300,000 women**, helping them transition from informal work or unemployment to formal roles in **manufacturing** and **services**.
 
• A key feature of the project is the creation of **supportive infrastructure**, including the development of **childcare centers** and **safe transportation** options, which are often major barriers to women's employment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu’s Industrial Context**: **Tamil Nadu** is one of India's most industrialized states and currently accounts for nearly **40%** of India's **women factory workers**. The state government aims to become a **$1 trillion economy** by **2030**, and increasing the **women’s labor force participation rate (LFPR)** is a critical component of this goal.
 
• **World Bank Group Financing**: The funding for this project is provided by the **International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)**. The loan has a **final maturity of 15 years**, which includes a **grace period of 5 years**, ensuring sustainable financial management for the state.
 
• **Support for Entrepreneurship**: Beyond direct employment, the **TN-WEEP** project will support **women-led MSMEs (Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises)** by improving their access to **finance**, **market linkages**, and **business development services**.
 
• **World Bank Overview**: Headquartered in **Washington, D.C.**, the **World Bank** was established in **1944** at the **Bretton Woods Conference**. It currently consists of **189 member countries** and is headed by President **Ajay Banga** (as of 2024-2025).
 
• **Focus on Gender Equality**: This initiative aligns with the **World Bank Group Gender Strategy (2024-2030)**, which focuses on accelerating **gender equality** for a sustainable and inclusive future by removing barriers to women’s **economic empowerment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Economic Impact**: Increasing **female participation** in the workforce is estimated to significantly boost the **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**. In India, bridging the **gender gap** in the labor market could potentially add over **20%** to the national **GDP**.
 
• **Urban and Rural Reach**: The project will operate across both **urban** and **rural areas** of **Tamil Nadu**, focusing on districts that are becoming industrial hubs, such as **Kancheepuram**, **Hosur**, and **Coimbatore**.
 
• **Partnership with State Government**: The **Government of Tamil Nadu** will implement the project through its specialized agencies, ensuring that the **skilling modules** are aligned with the actual **demand of the industry**.
 
• **Sustainability**: The program emphasizes **Green Jobs**, training women for roles in **solar panel manufacturing** and the **electric vehicle ecosystem**, aligning with global **climate action** goals.
